bio: Gabrielle Greene First-Year Social Committee Ivy Yard Hi! My name is Gabrielle Greene and I am from Philadelphia, Pennsylvania! I am a first year student currently living in Hollis Hall! I plan to concentrate in Government and History, with a secondary in Theater, Dance, and Media with hopefully a language citation in Italian. I am thrilled to be a part of FYSC and I can’t wait to help plan amazing events for the class of 2027 and create memorable moments this year! You’ll most likely find me in the Widener Library basement practicing my Italian Grammar. Don’t be afraid to say “Ciao!”
